plugin.name: AudioMuseAI
plugin.title: AudioMuse-AI
plugin.description: Adds an AudioMuse-AI entry under My Music with sonic similarity, album creation, hyperbolic explore, sonic fingerprint, instant text-prompt playlists with concept steering, mood presets and sonic moods, lyric themes, song alchemy, radios and anchors, find path (sonic / lyrics / hyperbolic), dynamic playlists and Don't Stop The Music with no-repeat auto-extend, and server admin controls. Requires a self-hosted AudioMuse-AI instance (v3.x recommended).
plugin.creator: JameZUK
